name: av_lim_nan_rhs
source:
{ The rhs goes NaN once the state crosses zero (sqrt of a negative). }
DYNAMIC nanny (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 4, points = 9)
  der(Yv) = -sqrt(Yv)
  Yv(0) = 1
END

error.message: Block 1 did not converge within 250 iterations (residual norm 6.51271e-05). Increase the iteration limit in Preferences or adjust guess values.
